pensamiento:
I'm going through the user stories one by one: QUS-001, 003, 004, 005, 007, 008 and 009 check out, and QUS-002 reads as one objective even though its criteria mention both available and accounting balance. For QUS-006, "en tiempo real" looks vague at first, but the criteria pin it to under 2 seconds, so that one is fine too. I'm now on the invariants, starting with INV-001.

I'm checking INV-002 and INV-005, which both seem to pass since INV-005's criterion is observable even though it only covers the happy path. INV-003 is harder to judge because it's missing error cases and a data source. For DOR-001, the saldo data could come from core banking, but since this story lives in the core system itself, the source may be internal, so I'm leaning toward not flagging it as a defect.

I'm checking DOR-002 next, since the criteria only cover a valid account number and never say what happens with an invalid or blocked account or what a cashier is allowed to see. That gap makes it a defect, so I'll flag it and then estimate.
